docs.purpose: Powers the admin Flight Center watchlist: lets an admin see their saved permits and committee-of-adjustment applications with each one's predicted start date and opportunity score, add a batch of new leads to that saved list, or remove a batch of them.
docs.data_story: It reads 7 tables — `admin_watchlist`, `permits`, `trade_forecasts`, `permit_trades`, `trades`, `coa_applications` and `lead_trades` and writes `admin_watchlist`. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 4 places: `admin_lead_feed`, `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useWatchlist.ts`, `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useBulkSaveToWatchlist.ts`, `src/features/admin-flight-center/api/useBulkDeleteFromWatchlist.ts`. It mutates admin state and writes **no `admin_audit_log` row** — one of the nine measured gaps Phase 0 closes.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: GET items are `{...row, temporal_group}` — a raw-row spread plus one computed field, not a hand-picked whitelist. POST/DELETE additionally require authMethod === 'session' (the shared admin_key sentinel is rejected 403; dev_bypass allowed) via forbiddenNonSessionWrite. POST insert is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING); DELETE is a hard delete scoped to admin_uid. NO admin audit row for the mutating methods. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: Census checklist: all 7 named tables VERIFIED. Census MISSED `profiles` (verifyAdminAuth, src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:117-120). FINDINGS: (1) COMMENT/CODE DISAGREEMENT — src/lib/admin/watchlist-temporal.ts:29 documents opportunity_score as 'MAX(opportunity_score) across the lead's active-trade forecasts', and :74 repeats 'MAX(opportunity_score) across all rows'; the actual GET SQL takes opportunity_score from the SAME row as the earliest predicted_start (route.ts:145-159, :185-199), which the route header at :25-28 correctly describes as same-row semantics. The JS mirror aggregateForecastRows (watchlist-temporal.ts:86-104) really does compute MAX, so the client-side reconcile helper and the server SQL can disagree for a lead whose max-score trade is not its earliest-start trade. (2) skipped_existing is derived arithmetically as valid.length - added (route.ts:365), so an INTRA-batch duplicate is reported as 'skipped_existing' even on a first-ever save — acknowledged in the comment at :338-339. (3) The POST INSERT builds its VALUES list by string concatenation (:341-351) but every value is a bound parameter ($1..$N) — parameterised, not injectable. (4) No SELECT * on a base table: the `SELECT *` at :120 reads the explicit-column subquery aliased `board` (:121-202). (5) No admin_audit_log row for either mutation, unlike the user-management routes — only breadcrumb + PostHog. (6) `dev_bypass` mutations are permitted (:73-79), so on a dev-mode deployment all rows land under uid 'dev-user' (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:82). | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control, no dynamic/revalidate, no in-process memo in route.ts:1-430 | Pagination: GET: LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3 at src/app/api/admin/leads/watchlist/route.ts:204 bound to WATCHLIST_PAGE_SIZE=50 (src/lib/admin/watchlist-schemas.ts:52) and the Zod-clamped offset (int >=0, max 1_000_000, src/lib/admin/watchlist-schemas.ts:56); `total` from a separate COUNT(*) at route.ts:207-209, returned in meta at :251-255. POST/DELETE: batch size capped at 1000 by Zod (watchlist-schemas.ts:99, :121). | Other guards / classification: MUTATION-ONLY identity gate: forbiddenNonSessionWrite at src/app/api/admin/leads/watchlist/route.ts:73-81 rejects authMethod==='admin_key' with 403; 'dev_bypass' writes are deliberately PERMITTED (:74 tests only admin_key).
